effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Task-boundary shared attack-memory DER++ adaptation: current and retained-old attack balanced CE, stored raw-logit MSE only over seen-at-admission outputs, independent old-memory replay CE. DUAL applies the latter two losses only to the stable contribution of the joint head; no plastic-branch distillation. Not online-reservoir DER++. No task-growing branches.
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: Section57 fixed lambda=.5, DER alpha=beta=1; no tuning
effective_config.family_parameter_constraint: constant through all stages; train and inference <=2x full eventual original attack-head F
effective_config.future_output_policy: unseen attack outputs masked; all parameter rows reserved at initialization
effective_config.section57_scope: old-seed development or exploratory CSE; no change to Section44 seal
effective_config.selection_aggregation: mean seeds5/6 final validation BAcc and signed old-class forgetting separately per dataset
effective_config.selection_validation_policy: fixed permanent stratified10percent attack TRAIN holdout plus permanent Normal TRAIN holdout; only seen classes; evaluation only; attack holdout outside M during selection only

limitations: Task-boundary shared attack-memory DER++ adaptation: current and retained-old attack balanced CE, stored raw-logit MSE only over seen-at-admission outputs, independent old-memory replay CE. DUAL applies the latter two losses only to the stable contribution of the joint head; no plastic-branch distillation. Not online-reservoir DER++. No task-growing branches.
Compact retention candidate; fixed attack validation outside M only during selection, never optimization or test-based tuning.
Two networks and refreshed benign data are not compute-matched to one-stage baselines.
Does not close RQ1/RQ3 or establish substantive novelty.

Designed after observing CSE18 results; old-seed runs are exploratory, not independent confirmation. Only retained old attacks receive gate KD; benign teacher-forward overhead is retained and accounted. The proposed mechanism interpretation remains a hypothesis.
